description:
Deletes a dashboard item property.

This operation can be accessed anonymously.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** The user must have edit permission of the dashboard.

parameters.description: The ID of the dashboard item.
parameters.name: itemId

parameters.description: The key of the dashboard item property.
parameters.name: propertyKey

204.description: Returned if the dashboard item property is deleted.

400.description: Returned if the dashboard or dashboard item ID is invalid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user is not the owner of the dashboard.

404.description: Returned if the dashboard item is not found or the dashboard is not shared with the user.
